notes.title: Update: 15th June 2018
notes.content:
New Score Mode Stage: Foosball Manikin!


[b]Patch Notes 1.0.2.4:

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

Score Mode:[/b]
We added a new Stage in Score Mode: Foosball Manikin!
Hit the Manikin to spin them around. The more they spin, the more points you get!

[h1]Updated:[/h1]

[b]Goal Mode:[/b]
-Improved animation of the Goal Keeper
-Added Sound to the Goal Keeper

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
-A failed ball now will be nullified directly after the shrink animation and can no longer score a goal.

tags.feature: We added a new Stage in Score Mode: Foosball Manikin!

tags.bug: -A failed ball now will be nullified directly after the shrink animation and can no longer score a goal.

notes.title: Update: 14th June 2018
notes.content:
New Power Up and full Oculus support!


[b]Patch Notes 1.0.2.2:

New Features:

Goal Mode:[/b]
Added a new Power Up "Heart"!
The Heart is a uniqie Power Up, which, if headed into the goal, recovers you a lost Live. But be careful! A heart can break easily, so make sure it does not touch the ground before it reaches the goal!
With the Power Up available you now can get 3 new Achievements:
[list]
    [*]Heart Over Head!
    [*]Love Is In The Air!
    [*]Endless Love!
[/list]


[b]General:[/b]
-Improved visuals of the ground texture
-Score Board will now get lit by spotlights when it displays your final score

Bug fixes:
-Fixed audio bug on Oculus. This means Oculus is now fully supported and we removed the warning text!
-Improved the head collision and it's physics precision

tags.feature: With the Power Up available you now can get 3 new Achievements:
Improved visuals of the ground texture
Score Board will now get lit by spotlights when it displays your final score

tags.bug: -Fixed audio bug on Oculus. This means Oculus is now fully supported and we removed the warning text!
-Improved the head collision and it's physics precision

notes.title: Update: 13th June 2018
notes.content:
Fixed Score Mode! (we are sooory~)

[b]Patch Notes 1.0.2.1:[/b]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
-The second Drone Stage in Score Mode now shoots Balls again (broken since last update 1.0.2.0).
-Furthermore now all Drones of the second Stage will give the correct Score values when hit.
-Final Stage in Score Mode is definitely fixed now.

[b]General:[/b]
-Added a warning note if you are starting the game without a VR-Headest plugged in.

HeadON! now includes Achievements!

Achievements:
-Added various Achievemnts to the game!
-Full list available here [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/816730/achievements]https://steamcommunity.com/stats/816730/achievements[/url] 
-The following Achievements will be available within the next patch:
[list]
    [*]All Drones Must Die!
[*]Drone Rights Activist!
[*]Combo Drone!
[*]Endless Love!
[*]Love Is In The Air!
[*]Heart Over Head!
[*]Living On The Edge!
[/list]

[b]General:[/b]
-Improved Occlusion Culling

Bug fixes:
-reduced the volume of the bomb explosion
-fixed a bug where a goal was not counted
-fixed score glitch in the final Stage of Score Mode

notes.title: Update: April 20th
notes.content:
We gave the Score Mode an overhaul! 

Patch Notes 1.0.1.4:

Score Mode:
-Every stage now has a set of random obstacles (except the final stage).
-Reduced the initial timer to 120 seconds (from 300 seconds).
-Increased the time bonus of every completed stage to 60 seconds (from 30 seconds).

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a bug in Score Mode where you only had 30 seconds to play, instead of 300.
-Fixed a problem where the wrong controller got marked as "main controller".
